item.title: awesome-agent-skills
item.description:
This repository bundles the following skills:

  • anthropics/docx: Creates and edits Word documents with formatting.
  • anthropics/xlsx: Builds and analyzes Excel spreadsheets.
  • anthropics/pdf: Extracts text from and creates PDF files.
  • serpapi/serpapi-web-search: Accesses 130+ search engines with structured results.
  • cloudflare/agents-sdk: Builds stateful AI agents with scheduling support.
  • openai/playwright: Browser automation for testing and scraping.
  • getsentry/sentry-workflow: Diagnoses and fixes production issues via Sentry.
  • stripe/stripe-best-practices: Guidance for integrating Stripe payments.
  • expo/building-native-ui: Guidance for building React Native apps with Expo.
  • firecrawl/firecrawl-build: Web scraping and content extraction.

item.title: awesome-claude-skills
item.description:
This repository bundles the following skills:

  • web-artifacts-builder: Tools for creating multi-component claude.ai HTML artifacts.
  • VibeSec-Skill: Helps Claude write secure code and avoid common vulnerabilities.
  • test-driven-development: Guidance for practicing test-driven development on features and bug fixes.
  • claude-scientific-skills: Over 125 scientific skills covering bioinformatics and clinical research.

item.title: awesome-claude-skills
item.description:
This repository bundles the following skills:

  • Connect: Lets Claude take real actions across more than 1,000 apps, including email and Slack.
  • MCP Builder: Guides the development of a Model Context Protocol server for an external API.
  • Changelog Generator: Builds a user-facing changelog automatically from git commit history.
  • Brand Guidelines: Applies Anthropic’s official branding to generated artifacts.
  • Skill Creator: Provides guidance for writing new, effective Claude Skills.
  • File Organizer: Sorts files by context and flags duplicates.
  • Content Research Writer: Researches a topic and drafts cited, edited sections of content.
  • Image Enhancer: Improves image resolution and clarity.
  • GitHub Automation: Automates GitHub issues, pull requests, and workflows.
  • Slack Automation: Automates Slack messaging and channel management.

item.title: awesome-claude-skills
item.description:
This repository bundles the following skills:

  • docx: Official Anthropic skill for creating and editing Word documents.
  • pdf: Official Anthropic skill for reading, filling, and generating PDF files.
  • pptx: Official Anthropic skill for building PowerPoint presentations.
  • algorithmic-art: Official skill for generating algorithmic and generative art.
  • mcp-builder: Official skill for building Model Context Protocol servers.
  • webapp-testing: Official skill for testing web applications.
  • brand-guidelines: Official skill for applying brand style guidelines to content.
  • obra/superpowers: Community skills library for Claude Code with over 20 coding skills.
